speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The clinical picture of apnea and anemia in a premature infant, combined with maternal non-immunity to rubella and placental insufficiency, strongly suggests congenital rubella syndrome, which can cause congenital heart defects (explaining the apnea/anemia) and bone marrow suppression (anemia). The family history of a heart condition in the father likely refers to the infant's own undiagnosed cardiac defect.
